weaknesses.critique: The claim is about full year 2025 revenue growth, but the only specific evidence cited (E2) covers only Q3 2025. While Q3 2025 shows broad-based growth across all regions, this is only one quarter and may not be representative of the full year 2025. The evidence does not provide full-year 2025 data or data from other quarters in 2025 to confirm that the broad-based growth pattern held throughout the entire year.

The claim date is 'as_of_date: 2026-02-28' and the 10-K for FY2025 (E4, E5) was filed on 2026-01-29, which should contain full-year 2025 results. However, the specific geographic revenue growth figures for full year 2025 are not quoted from the 10-K evidence. The verdict relies on Q3 quarterly data rather than the annual data that should be available in the 10-K filing.

Evidence E4 and E6 mention that 'we have seen fluctuations and declines in the size of our active user base in one or more regions from time to time due to geopolitical conditions, which have adversely affected our user growth and engagement' and that 'These trends have adversely affected our advertising revenue.' While this doesn't directly contradict broad-based revenue growth, it suggests there may have been regional variations or challenges that could complicate the characterization of growth as uniformly 'broad-based' across all regions throughout 2025.
